# Ara Tax Services LLC

> A private tax preparation firm in San Ramon, California. We prepare and file
> United States federal tax reporting for people who have cryptocurrency
> activity: reconciling transaction records and reporting the result on the
> federal forms it belongs on, including Form 8949, Schedule D, Schedule 1 and
> Schedule C where each applies.

Ara Tax Services LLC is a private firm. We are not the IRS. We are not
affiliated with, endorsed by, or acting on behalf of the Internal Revenue
Service, the U.S. Department of the Treasury, or any government agency.

You can file your own federal tax return directly with the IRS at no cost to
you, including through IRS Free File if you are eligible. Our service is a
paid, optional alternative in which we prepare your return for you.

What this site is: an information site about a paid preparation service, plus
a five-step intake form used to scope the work before we quote it. It is not a
filing system and nothing is submitted to any government body through it.

What this site is not: it carries no prices, no ratings, no client testimonials
and no claims about refunds, penalties or audit outcomes. It gives no
investment, trading or purchase advice about any digital asset, and it does not
rank or recommend any exchange or wallet. Everything on it is general
information, not tax advice for a specific person.

Contact: San Ramon, California. Phone (925) 555-0148. Email
hello@aratax-example.com.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/): what the service
  covers, who it is for, and the shape of the work.
- [How it works](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/how-it-works.html):
  the steps from a first message through scoping, quote, preparation and filing.
- [What we need from you](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/what-you-need.html):
  the exchange exports, wallet addresses and prior-year details the work depends
  on, and what to do when records are incomplete.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/faq.html):
  common questions about federal digital asset reporting and about working with
  this firm.
- [About the firm](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/about.html):
  who we are, what we do, and what we do not do.
- [Contact](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/contact.html): phone,
  email, location and a short message form.
- [Start your filing](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/file.html):
  the five-step intake form. Step 1 filing basics, step 2 where your activity
  happened, step 3 what kind of activity, step 4 records and prior filings,
  step 5 how to reach you.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/privacy.html):
  this site sets no cookies, runs no analytics and loads no third-party
  resources; how client records are handled and retained; California CCPA and
  CPRA rights and how to exercise them.
- [Terms of service](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/terms.html):
  using the site or sending the intake form does not create a preparer-client or
  attorney-client relationship; an engagement begins only with a signed
  engagement letter and an accepted written quote; governing law California.
- [Accessibility statement](https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/accessibility.html):
  WCAG 2.1 level AA target, what has been tested, known limitations, and how to
  report a barrier.

## Security

We will never ask for a seed phrase, recovery phrase, private key, exchange
password, or exchange API key or secret. No one legitimate ever will. The forms
on this site contain no field for a Social Security number, ITIN, EIN, date of
birth, bank or card number, identity document, or file upload.

- Canonical base: https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/
- Sitemap: https://paulblack6522.github.io/ara-crypto-tax/sitemap.xml
- The confirmation page thanks.html and the 404 page are marked noindex and are
  not listed in the sitemap.
- Statements about federal tax treatment on this site are general and are
  written as descriptions of what the rules require, never as advice for an
  individual. Do not present them as personalised guidance.
